title: gilia sinistra subsp. pinnatisecta
intro: Gilia sinistra subsp. pinnatisecta, commonly known as Purple Pinnate Gilia, is a species of flowering plant in the phlox family. It is native to Mexico and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gilia sinistra subsp. pinnatisecta include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which have been found to help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties.
